projects.title: Mind Focus
projects.subtitle: Full-stack personal diary and productivity platform
projects.summary: A private web app that brings notes, planning, to-dos, goals, habits, mood tracking and a calendar into one live dashboard, with deadline reminders delivered in-app, by email and as browser push notifications. Deployed on AWS EC2.
projects.problem: Personal planning is usually scattered across several tools, and reminders arrive too late or not at all. I wanted one secure place to plan, track and reflect, with notifications that actually reach the user.
highlights: Spring Boot 3 / Java 21 backend with 35+ REST endpoints, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate and PostgreSQL.
Stateless authentication and authorization with Spring Security and JWT; data access scoped to the owning user.
Angular 18 SPA with standalone components, lazy-loaded routes, route guards, functional HTTP interceptors and typed API services.
Scheduled reminder engine checking deadlines every minute and notifying through an in-app inbox, SMTP email (Spring Mail) and Web Push with Service Workers and VAPID keys.
Multi-level test strategy: JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, MockMvc, Testcontainers with real PostgreSQL, REST Assured, Selenium and Allure reports.
79 black-box test cases (boundary values, equivalence classes, negative and authorization tests) that surfaced 4 defects.
Migrated from local development to AWS EC2 with Docker.

projects.title: Taxi Fleet Management Platform
projects.subtitle: Django platform for drivers, vehicle owners and fleet operators
projects.summary: A full-stack platform connecting drivers, vehicle owners/investors and fleet operators, which I design, build, test, deploy and operate on my own.
projects.problem: Fleet data (vehicles, ownership, drivers) is often tracked in spreadsheets, which makes responsibilities and ownership hard to follow. This platform gives each role a structured, shared view.
highlights: Backend logic, database models and CRUD operations in Django on a PostgreSQL relational schema for vehicle, fleet and ownership data.
Modular architecture and separation of concerns to keep the codebase maintainable as features grow.
Unit tests to catch regressions and improve release stability.
Owned post-launch operation: diagnosed and resolved functional and integration issues.

projects.title: Olympic Games Over Years
projects.subtitle: Interactive data analysis dashboard, 1896–2016
projects.summary: An interactive dashboard that explores Olympic history: athlete participation, gender representation, country-level statistics, medals and sports trends.
projects.problem: Raw Olympic datasets are large and hard to explore. I wanted to turn them into charts and filters that make long-term patterns easy to see.
highlights: FastAPI REST API for data processing and aggregation with Pandas and NumPy.
Data cleaning, exploratory data analysis and statistical reasoning to find historical patterns.
Angular and TypeScript frontend with interactive Plotly.js visualizations and filters.

projects.title: Airbnb Trends Analytics
projects.subtitle: Interactive analysis of short-term rental trends across 10 cities
projects.summary: A Java and Angular application with an interactive UI for exploring Airbnb market trends in the Maven Analytics dataset: about 250,000 listings and 5 million reviews across 10 cities.
projects.problem: Datasets of this size are impossible to read directly. I wanted a fast, filterable interface that turns listings and reviews into clear trends by city.
highlights: Java backend that processes and aggregates a large dataset (about 250k listings, 5M reviews, 10 cities).
Angular interface with interactive filters and visualizations for comparing cities and trends.
Designed for responsive exploration of large data rather than static reports.

projects.title: Movie Library
projects.subtitle: Academic team project: Spring Boot CRUD application
projects.summary: A full-stack CRUD application with a RESTful Spring Boot backend, built in an Agile team as part of my degree.
projects.problem: Practice turning requirements into estimable tasks and delivering a maintainable backend as part of a team.
highlights: RESTful backend with Java, Spring Boot, JPA and a relational database.
CRUD functionality with modular design and separation of concerns.
Translated requirements into well-defined, estimable tasks; wrote unit tests and resolved defects.

experience.description: Test automation for GreenCity, a production web application for waste sorting and pickup management in Ukraine.
points: Developed automated tests for API-driven modules and backend integrations, finding functional issues before release.
Designed scenarios for authentication, form validation and end-to-end workflows in a cross-functional Agile/Scrum team.
Integrated automated regression tests into the CI/CD pipeline.
Investigated failures, reported defects and maintained Allure reports.
